issues.description: Method 'calculateTotalPrice(Meal)' is specified in the problem statement to be static, but the solution implements it as an instance method. Problem statement: lines 77-81 require calculateTotalPrice to be static (shared across instances and operating on the shared static stock). Solution: SealSaloon.java declares 'public int calculateTotalPrice(Meal meal)' (instance method). This mismatch can confuse students about whether the method should be declared static and how it should be invoked (SealSaloon.calculateTotalPrice(...) vs instance.calculateTotalPrice(...)), and may cause automated checks or grading tests that expect a static signature to fail.
issues.suggestedFix: Align the implementation with the problem statement: change the SealSaloon method signature to 'public static int calculateTotalPrice(Meal meal)' and update any call sites to invoke it statically (e.g., SealSaloon.calculateTotalPrice(meal)). Alternatively, if the intended design is instance-based, update the problem statement to remove the requirement that calculateTotalPrice be static and clarify that it is an instance method.
